concepts.gloss_en: The 'tallit' (garment/encompassing) of the klipah — the impure shell, identified with the tallit of Edom

members.note: representative; the garment of the klipah itself

concepts.gloss_en: The subjugation/subduing of the tallit of the klipah — an action upon the shell-garment, not the garment itself

members.note: representative; state/action of the klipah-garment being subdued via the holy tallit, distinct from the object per rule 4 (action about X ≠ X)

notes: Rule 4: 'subjugation of the tallit of klipah' is a state/action about the object, not the object; kept separate despite token overlap. Both appear only in lm1:8.
